c-b3f7c5ff0cd2580f.texto: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading-troughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

c-cc809da86ceb5858.texto: The reason for their violating their ordinary usage is here given: they were in haste.

h-0773e8b9b91dfa05.texto: Rango 'fecha temprana' del éxodo (basado en 1 Reyes 6:1, cronología tradicional). JFB no tiene introducción propia a Éxodo en el repositorio (empieza directo en Éx 1); Poole tampoco.
